# RNNoise model

`rnnoise-model.bin` is the binary model used by RNNoise commit
`70f1d256acd4b34a572f999a05c87bf00b67730d`.

It was generated with RNNoise's `dump_weights_blob` tool from the official
model bundle whose source-model SHA-256 is
`0a8755f8e2d834eff6a54714ecc7d75f9932e845df35f8b59bc52a7cfe6e8b37`.
The bundled binary SHA-256 is
`1ad07b428be34c74d9678d05b3c387b73ccf0e6203a1a5f9ce58689b30b303c8`.

`rnnoise_data.h` and the small initializer in `rnnoise_data.c` describe that
model's network layout and are generated by the same upstream build. Keeping
them here makes CubicSDR builds offline and reproducible without committing
RNNoise's roughly 74 MB embedded weight array.
